artworks.title: Crouching Man (L’Homme accroupi)
artworks.creditLine:
Gift of James A. Bergquist, Boston,
in honor of Shelley R.Langdale
artworks.description: The image shows a serene landscape portrayed through etching techniques. The viewpoint is at eye level, showcasing a river flowing through the scene. The horizon is high, framed by dense vegetation and tall trees. The print features intricate strokes for detail and texture, with darker tones illustrating the foliage. The river surface displays light and shadow effects. Trees in the distance contribute to the scene's depth. The artwork uses a monochromatic palette of black and gray.

artworks.title: Study of Trees beside the Water (Étude d’arbres au bord d’une mare)
artworks.creditLine:
Gift of James A. Bergquist, Boston,
in honor of Shelley R.Langdale
artworks.description: The image shows a landscape with a grove of trees. The horizon is low, above the base of the tree trunks. There are tall trees with branches extending upwards, filling much of the sky. The etching technique creates varied line thicknesses, giving the trees and foliage a textured appearance. The color palette is monochromatic with shades of brown. A small body of water reflects the landscape. In the distance, the density of trees decreases, and the detailing becomes more delicate towards the edges of the image.

artworks.title: A t Pontchéry, Isère (A Pontcheruy , Isère, vue d’une chute d’eau)
artworks.medium: etching and drypoint on tan laid paper
artworks.creditLine:
Gift of James A. Bergquist, Boston,
in honor of Shelley R.Langdale
artworks.description: The image presents a landscape view captured in an etching style. The horizon is high in the image, with a line of trees in the distance marking the edge of the riverbank. A river winds through the scene, bordered by rocks and trees with detailed foliage, prominent on the right side. The color palette is monochromatic using shades of black on a white background.

artworks.title: Bois de la charbonnière
artworks.medium: etching and drypoint on tan laid paper
artworks.creditLine:
Gift of James A. Bergquist, Boston,
in honor of Shelley R.Langdale
artworks.description: The image depicts a landscape with an upward perspective, showing trees reaching towards the sky. The horizon is visible at the top of the image where the trees blend with the sky. There is no specific element on the horizon. The focus is on the details of the trees, depicted with fine brushstrokes showing intricate branches and leaf patterns. The color palette is monochromatic with shades of black and grey. The ground is uneven with shadows, adding depth. In the background, there are more trees fading slightly to suggest distance.

artworks.title: Pietro Berrettini da Cortona
artworks.creditLine:
Gift of James A. Bergquist, Boston,
in honor of Shelley R.Langdale
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a winged figure seated with classical ruins in the background. The figure, muscular and in a seated position, is depicted with wings and is holding a medallion with a profile portrait. Below the winged figure, there is a partially reclining figure. The background features stone structures resembling pyramids or obelisks and distant trees. The composition is shaded with fine lines, showcasing intricate detailing. The base of the monument bears an inscription in Italian. The style echoes that of baroque artists, with dramatic poses and emphasis on anatomy and expression.

artworks.title: Veduta: Design for a Garden Court with a Mountain View
artworks.creditLine:
Gift of James A. Bergquist, Boston,
in honor of Shelley R.Langdale
artworks.description: The image depicts a classical architectural scene with natural elements seen from a slightly elevated point of view. On the left side, there are tall columns, a pot with plants, and a statue on a pedestal. Further back, an arched structure covered in greenery is visible. In the distance, a mountain is seen near a bridge with arches spanning a river or road. The etching shows fine and delicate brushstrokes, especially in the architectural and foliage textures. The color palette consists of primarily black and white, with stark contrasts creating depth and shadows. The horizon line is suggested by the base of the mountain and bridge, enhancing the sense of depth in the landscape.

artworks.title: Design for a Garden Court
artworks.creditLine:
Gift of James A. Bergquist, Boston,
in honor of Shelley R.Langdale
artworks.description: The image is an engraving of an architectural scene with a courtyard, sculptures, stone carvings, a basin with a dog, a woman in a flowing dress, and a grand pavilion with columns. The perspective shows depth with small figures and sculptures in the background. The engravings capture intricate details of the architecture and textures of stone and foliage in a monochromatic color palette, emphasizing contrast and detail using light and shadow.

artworks.title: The Adoration of the Shepherds
artworks.artist: François Chauveau, after Laurent de La Hyre
artworks.medium: etching with engraving on laid paper
artworks.creditLine:
Gift of James A. Bergquist, Boston,
in honor of Shelley R.Langdale
artworks.description: The image depicts a group of people in a historical setting. A woman is seated and holds a small child, while a man stands next to her holding a basket. Other individuals are surrounding them, all dressed in similar robes. The background shows large columns and architectural elements, suggesting a grand setting like a cityscape or ancient ruin.

artworks.title: Pig in an Orchard (Le Cochon dans un verger)
artworks.creditLine:
Gift of James A. Bergquist, Boston,
in honor of Shelley R.Langdale

artworks.title: Solon Salaminius
artworks.creditLine:
Gift of James A. Bergquist, Boston,
in honor of Shelley R.Langdale
artworks.description: The image shows a man walking up a flight of steps. He is in a three-quarter profile, holding a helmet with a plume covering his face. He wears classical clothing, including a skirt-like garment, a cape draped over his left shoulder, and sandals. The man carries a shield in his left hand and a sword at his waist. In the background are architectural elements like columns and more steps, with another helmet on the ground next to the steps.

artworks.title: Bailadoras (Andalucia)
artworks.medium: etching and aquatint printed from multiple plates in color on tan wove paper
artworks.creditLine:
Gift of James A. Bergquist, Boston,
in honor of Shelley R.Langdale
artworks.description: The image shows four women walking in traditional dresses with floral designs. They are viewed from a side angle, creating a sense of movement. The women have partially visible facial features and styled hair. Each wears a colorful dress with floral patterns, and one carries a fan. The background features faint outlines of figures and architectural elements.

artworks.title: Jean Baptiste Isabey
artworks.creditLine:
Gift of James A. Bergquist, Boston,
in honor of Shelley R.Langdale
artworks.description: The image shows an elderly man standing upright. He is facing slightly to his left and appears to be about to step forward. He has a closely shaved beard, a receding hairline with curly hair on the sides, and is wearing a long, dark overcoat over a buttoned jacket and trousers. He is holding a top hat in his right hand and a walking cane in his left hand. In the background, there is a sketch-like natural landscape with trees and undulating terrain visible.

artworks.title: Hermes Bringing the Infant Dionysus to the Nymphs
artworks.creditLine:
Gift of James A. Bergquist, Boston,
in honor of Shelley R.Langdale
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a classical mythological scene set in a natural landscape. The drawing shows a group of figures gathered around a central figure who appears to be reclining. The figures are depicted with flowing robes and intricate drapery, conveying movement and interaction. The scene is surrounded by lush trees and shrubs, with a visible water body in the background. The composition is detailed, with fine lines cross-hatching used for shading, giving depth and texture to the figures and the environment.

artworks.title: Théocrite (Theorcritus)
artworks.creditLine:
Gift of James A. Bergquist, Boston,
in honor of Shelley R.Langdale
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a pastoral scene featuring two figures. One figure is seated leaning against a tree while the other stands beside them. The landscape is lush with trees, rolling hills, and varied terrain. Fine detailing of foliage and terrain give the scene a lifelike quality, while the figures' clothing suggests a classical or historical influence.

artworks.title: Parcere Subiectis (The Magnanimous Treatment of Prisoners)
artworks.creditLine:
Gift of James A. Bergquist, Boston,
in honor of Shelley R.Langdale
artworks.description: The image shows three main figures and two background figures in an outdoor setting. All figures are fully visible. One central figure, likely male, stands with a commanding posture, extending his right arm outward. This figure has a delicate facial structure with short hair gathered under a headpiece, and is adorned in a toga-like garment with gladiatorial sandals. Next to him is a kneeling male figure who appears to be kissing the outstretched hand. Another man standing behind him glances over his shoulder. One of the background figures wears Roman soldier’s armor with a decorative helmet and shield. The backdrop features tall palm trees, a building with columns, and a fabric banner with the letters "SPQR." The scene takes place on a stone or tiled ground, with a stray helmet and shield resting on the ground.

artworks.title: Sir Frederic Leighton
artworks.creditLine:
Gift of James A. Bergquist, Boston,
in honor of Shelley R.Langdale
artworks.description: The image shows a profile portrait of a man drawn in a sketch style. The man's head and partial shoulder are depicted, facing right. He appears to be an older man with distinctive facial features, including a prominent nose, beard, and wavy hair that reaches the nape of his neck. The man wears a simple garment without visible details or accessories. The background is plain with a light texture, and the sketch is framed within a rectangular border on a broader canvas.

artworks.title: Peasant Woman with Closed Eyes
artworks.creditLine:
Gift of James A. Bergquist, Boston,
in honor of Shelley R.Langdale
artworks.description: This image shows a portrait of a woman in profile, facing left. Only her head and the upper part of her shoulders are visible. The woman has detailed facial features and lines indicating older age. Her hair is pulled back and covered by a cap or headscarf tied at the back of her neck. She wears a scarf or shawl around her shoulders, tied at the front. There are no visible jewelry or objects in her hands. The background is plain.

artworks.title: Resting Herdsman
artworks.creditLine:
Gift of James A. Bergquist, Boston,
in honor of Shelley R.Langdale

artworks.title: Cavalier on Horseback
artworks.medium: etching on laid paper, mounted on wove paper
artworks.creditLine:
Gift of James A. Bergquist, Boston,
in honor of Shelley R.Langdale
artworks.description: The image shows a man on horseback. He sits upright on the horse, holding reins in one hand and a riding crop in the other. The man's face is shown in profile, with distinct features and facial hair. He wears a tricorn hat, a long coat, and boots. The horse is in motion, lifting one front leg, with a detailed mane and tail. The background includes a simple landscape with sky and vegetation.

artworks.title: View into the Court of the Lions at the Alhambra
artworks.creditLine:
Gift of James A. Bergquist, Boston,
in honor of Shelley R.Langdale
artworks.description: The image shows an architectural illustration of El Patio de los Leones in Granada. The perspective is centered and symmetrical, with the main building situated in the middle and slightly above the horizontal center. The horizon is low, just above the people and fountain. The fountain is detailed and serves as a focal point. The illustration uses fine line engravings to create depth and texture in the patterns and architecture. The color palette is monochrome, mainly in sepia and brown tones. Elegant figures are shown conversing and walking in the foreground, adding scale and liveliness. The arches and columns extend into the distance, framing the scene and guiding the viewer's gaze towards the central building's intricate facade.

artworks.title: Royal Palace, Toledo
artworks.creditLine:
Gift of James A. Bergquist, Boston,
in honor of Shelley R.Langdale
artworks.description: The image shows an engraving of a stately building and its surroundings. The horizon is high in the image showcasing mountains in the distance under a cloudy sky. A large detailed building, potentially a palace, is on the left on a rocky outcrop. The engraving has fine detailed brushstrokes capturing architectural details and landscape textures. It has a monochromatic color palette of black and white, emphasizing intricate line work and shading. Smaller buildings can be seen descending towards the valley beyond the main building, enhancing the perception of depth.

artworks.title: La Fantastique quadrille
artworks.creditLine:
Gift of James A. Bergquist, Boston,
in honor of Shelley R.Langdale
artworks.description: This is a drawing featuring a central figure playing a Pan flute, surrounded by various characters and decorative elements. The border contains additional scenes and figures that suggest a narrative or allegory. Figures and animals are depicted interacting on the left, while classical attired figures and cherubic forms are on the right. Floral motifs and small figures fill the spaces, creating a sense of movement and festivity. The style and detail resemble 19th-century illustrations known for intricate and narrative-driven compositions.

artworks.title: The Nativity
artworks.medium: etching with engraving on laid paper
artworks.creditLine:
Gift of James A. Bergquist, Boston,
in honor of Shelley R.Langdale
artworks.description: The image shows several figures gathered around an infant in a makeshift crib. The scene includes people kneeling or standing around the infant, some looking down at the child. The central figure holding the infant has delicate facial features and is centrally positioned. The individuals have varied hairstyles, mostly long or shoulder-length and wavy. They are dressed in flowing robes and wraps. One person is holding a lamb. Cherubs hover above the scene with wings spread wide. The setting is a rustic structure or stable with a partially thatched roof and support beams. In the background, hilly landscapes with trees are visible.

artworks.title: Artus Quellinus the Elder
artworks.dimensions:
plate: 31.5 × 22.5 cm (12 3/8 × 8 7/8 in.)
sheet: 31.7 × 22.5 cm (12 1/2 × 8 7/8 in.), trimmed to platemark
artworks.creditLine:
Gift of James A. Bergquist, Boston,
in honor of Shelley R.Langdale
artworks.description: The image shows an engraved portrait of a man's upper half. He is positioned slightly turned to his right with his head facing forward. The man has a mature face with a mustache and shoulder-length wavy hair. He is dressed in a period-appropriate garment with a high collar and lace cravat. One hand is on his chest, and the other hand is visible at the bottom of the frame. The portrait is within an oval frame decorated with a leaf garland. The background has a fine texture, and below the portrait is a script inscription with the name "Artus Quellinius" and additional text.
